scope: Audit of existing Bitcoin five-minute probability model; no orders or model promotion
sources: Existing original 2020-2025 archives and previously acquired Jan-Aug 2026 archives; no new data acquisition
preservation: Original source, model, predictions, panel, and prior experiment results remain unchanged

audit_refits.purpose: Diagnose model age using two predetermined expanding-window refits; historical diagnostics, not independent confirmation or a strategy search
audit_refits.parameters: Identical original 15 features, standardized logistic C=0.1, separate Platt C=1, seed42
audit_refits.ties: Train/calibrate on original non-tie binary definition; evaluation predicts every causally eligible decision and accounts for zero-return ties
audit_refits.threshold: Fixed long >=0.55, short <=0.45; no threshold optimization
audit_refits.economics: Reuse prior fixed-horizon ledger with Binance bar-reference prices, funding, and 0/2/4/6bps round-trip sensitivities

limits: All historical data are already exposed. Audit comparisons diagnose flaws and cannot establish a deployable or independently confirmed profitable model. Group mean replacement is a sensitivity diagnostic rather than retrained feature ablation. Actual publication latency and executable order books are unavailable.
